instruction: Candid photographic medium close-up in a bright ballet studio with wooden barres. In the foreground, the red-haired girl in a pink leotard (R3) smiles with her head turned right and left arm extended. Behind her, the light-brown-haired girl in a pink leotard (R1) stands with her arm extended backward. In the background, a female instructor in a black shirt and grey trousers guides the dancers. Soft, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the pink outfits against the neutral white walls.
